title: 第320章 找到怪谈规则第319章 妄镇
slug: 无敌镖人开局护送灭世帝女
lines: 那老头随即又摇头，“不对……不对，这是怪谈规则的幻境，不能上当！”
他强行压一下心中的激动，不停警告自己眼前一切都是虚妄。
然而下一秒，一个光团像是活过来一般，嗖的一声，主动钻入了她的身体。
那个老头身心一震，紧接着内心狂喜，当即仰天长啸。
“我竟然突破到天人了，突破到天人了！”
“是真的！这真的是祖源！”
“祖源，这些祖源都是我的！”
而他的在众人的视角里，就是站在原地自言自语，一脸激动。
众人心中大骇，“老猪头，你这是怎么了？”
而下一秒，就见这个老家伙身形突然鼓胀起来，越鼓越大，最后像个吹爆气球，砰的一下爆碎，炸成漫天血雾，溅了周围那群老家伙一身！
这一下，直接给这一群老家伙吓坏了。
“这到底是什么怪谈规则？”
“怎会如此诡异？！”
而陈观则皱了皱眉。
他又得出了一个结论：这怪谈规则触发的是某种“妄想症”，而且还不是同时让人激发，只是随机。
刚才这个爆炸老家伙，运气好，抽中了头奖。
颜宝儿看到这一幕，吓得小脸惨白。
陈观见状，只得开口安慰道。
“放心，有我在，你不会触发这种生死考验。”
“哦……”颜宝儿半信半疑地点了点头。
颜宝儿再次迈开腿，沿着镇中的街道，朝着深处走去。
路上，陈观不断提醒她观察周围情况，获取信息。
可没过一会，身后又突然传来一阵惊喜的嚎叫。
陈观回头看去。
只见那群老家伙中有一个，眼神痴迷，一边脱着衣服，一边嘴里还念念有词。
“小翠翠……你……你这样做，对得起我儿子吗……”
“啊！老不休！”颜宝儿猛的捂住眼睛，赶紧地转过头去。
然而在陈观的视角中，那个老家伙的身形正在迅速干瘪，不过几个呼吸的工夫，一身精气便消失得一干二净。
显然是被那个所谓的“小翠翠”给吸干了。
周围那些老家伙再也无法淡定，一个个亡魂大冒。
他们可是知道，这个死掉的老家伙一向以克制、谨慎而著称。
可就是这样一个人，在明知道这里是怪谈规则之地的情况下，还是中了招。
“这这这这……”
有些人已经产生退缩之意，但一想到悬在他们头顶上的渡厄司，他们又将这退意给生生压了下去。
别人不清楚司王的手段，他们这些诡族之人怎么可能不知道？
每百年，司王便要收割一个祟族；每千年，便要覆灭一个诡族。
如果他们今日敢退，明年就是他们身后种族的忌日！
想到这里，他们猛地看向陈观，将一切恨意都嫁接到了他身上。
都是这个小子！
非要闯这该死的无妄疆！
如果不是他，我们又怎么会被派到这里来！
content_en:
The old man then shook his head again, "No... no, this is an illusion with strange rules, don't be fooled!"
He suppressed the excitement in his heart and kept warning himself that everything in front of him was false.
However, the next second, a ball of light seemed to come alive, and with a whoosh, it actively penetrated into her body.
The old man was shaken physically and mentally, and then he was so ecstatic that he looked up to the sky and roared.
"I actually made a breakthrough to heaven, I made a breakthrough to heaven!"
"It's true! This is really the origin!"
"Ancestors, these ancestors are mine!"
From everyone's perspective, he was standing there talking to himself, with an excited look on his face.
Everyone was shocked, "Old Zhutou, what's wrong with you?"
And the next second, I saw this old guy suddenly swelled up, getting bigger and bigger, and finally exploded like a blown balloon, exploding into a mist of blood that filled the sky, splashing all over the surrounding old guys!
"This... this, this..."
This time, this group of old guys were frightened.
"What kind of weird rule is this?"
"How could it be so weird?!"
Chen Guan frowned.
He came to another conclusion: this weird rule triggered some kind of "paranoia", and it didn't trigger people at the same time, it was just random.
The explosive old guy just now was lucky and won the first prize.
When Yan Baoer saw this scene, her face turned pale with fright.
Seeing this, Chen Guan had no choice but to comfort him.
"Don't worry, with me here, you won't trigger this life and death test."
"Oh..." Yan Baoer nodded dubiously.
Yan Baoer opened her legs again and walked deeper along the streets of the town.
On the way, Chen Guan kept reminding her to observe the surrounding situation and obtain information.
But after a while, there was a sudden howl of surprise from behind.
Chen Guan looked back.
I saw one of those old guys with obsessed eyes, taking off his clothes and mumbling something.
"Xiao Cuicui... you... are you worthy of my son by doing this..."
"Ah! I'm so stubborn!" Yan Baoer covered his eyes fiercely and turned his head quickly.
However, from Chen Guan's perspective, the old guy's figure was rapidly drying up, and in just a few breaths, all his energy disappeared.
Apparently she was sucked dry by the so-called "Little Cuicui".
The old guys around them could no longer remain calm, and their dead souls emerged one after another.
They knew that this dead old guy had always been known for his restraint and caution.
But it was such a person who fell into the trap even though he knew that this was a place where ghost stories had rules.
"This, this, this..."
Some people already had the intention of retreating, but when they thought of Duoes hanging above their heads, they suppressed their intention to retreat.
Others don't know King Si's methods, how could they, the people of the Wei Clan, not know?
Every hundred years, King Si will harvest a Kuei clan; every thousand years, a Kuai clan will be destroyed.
If they dare to retreat today, next year will be the death anniversary of the race behind them!
Thinking of this, they looked at Chen Guan suddenly, grafting all their hatred onto him.
It’s all this kid!
I have to break through this damn boundless frontier!
If it weren't for him, why would we be sent here!
"snort!"
